resume.about_me:
Hi, I'm Frank Bosma, a freelance creative developer from Amsterdam.

I love to create, and to connect people with purpose through playful experiences. Whether that’s online or offline.

I have been developing since 2001 and keeping up with this ever evolving digital landscape of languages, libraries and methodologies means there's never a dull moment. My expertise ranges from front end to back end, from apps, services, installations & sites to Virtual and Augmented Reality. Just hand me an API, and I'll find my way.
resume.skills:

**Knowledgeable:**

Unreal, TypeScript, Python, Docker, Next.js, Vite, GraphQL, Max MSP, PHP, ASP, JSP, Java, Arduino/C++, MySQL, NoSQL (CouchDB)

project.resume: I'm working as a lead developer on ‘Gay Simulator’, an interactive VR experience & video game by artist Iris van der Meule that introduces you in a poetic way to the world of a lesbian. It is an artistic ode to sexual orientation, love and sexuality with a serious undertone. It portrays the modern forms of discrimination against lesbians.
project.title: Gay Simulator

project.resume:
Ancestors is a mobile immersive project by the Smartphone Orchestra focusing on connecting an audience using a very ‘familiar’ way, to talk about how to take care of future generations. I was the lead developer of the Artifical Intelligence part (Stable Diffusion and Docker), admin backend (NodeJS, Firebase) and webapp frontend (React+Typescript) to create artificial future generations of the audience.
Ancestors premiered November 2024 at IDFA festival, won the Best Of Tech award at Miami FilmGate Interactive and will be playing at SXSW 2025 in Austin, Texas.
project.title: Ancestors

project.resume:
I joined the 3D design team for the 30 minute VR experience Lacuna, where participants are exploring a story of loss and grief through a series of fragmented memories and imagination. An experience that leads from Paramaribo to Amsterdam and back, via the Jewish psychiatric hospital 'Het Apeldoornsche Bosch'. Together with the protagonist you try to unravel what the exact story might have been.
Lacuna had its premiere at IFFR festival in Rotterdam, January 2025.
project.title: Lacuna

project.resume: We Are Dead Animals is a project in collaboration with animator Maarten Isaäk de Heer. Based on his 2022 IDFA DocLab dome projection and danse macabre project Dancing With Dead Animals, We Are Dead Animals transposes the animations of said project to a Virtual Reality interactive version.
project.title: We Are Dead Animals

project.resume:
I was the lead developer of The Imaginary Friend, a surrealistic interactive and cinematic Virtual Reality experience making use of volumetric video capture (technology from [4drstudios](https://4drstudios.com/en/)) to involve the viewer as intimately as possible in the story of Daniel and his vivid imagination.

The Imaginary Friend had its international premiere at Venice Immersive 2023, was nominated for a Gouden Kalf (Beste Digtale Cultuurproductie 2023) at the Netherlands Film Festival and was on display at SXSW in Austin, Texas 2024.
project.title: The Imaginary Friend

project.resume:
Kids grow up in a world where online and offline are merging. The library of the future wants to welcome everyone into this world and let you become one of its co-creators. The Spacebeest installation represents making, playing and a sense of belonging.
Together with OBA's (Amsterdam Public Library) Ontwerplab I created the installation where kids could turn their analog drawings into digital, moving and interactive creatures, while learning about digitizing and coding through play. The installation toured in libraries around Amsterdam as well as the Eindhoven library during the [Dutch Design Week](https://ddw.nl/en/programme/7890/spacebeest-maak-je-eigen-ruimtemonster).
project.title: Spacebeest

project.resume: As part of the STRP festival 2022 in Eindhoven I developed an Augmented Reality project with designer duo [HyperCulture](https://hyperculture.nl/), called [INFINITY](https://infinitycollection.nl/). This collection of audio-virtual works of art are only on display at carefully selected physical locations. At STRP that will be the Heuvel galerie shopping mall. A mall that since Corona has seen numerous shops disappear, leaving empty physical spaces. What will be the future of these spaces in an ever growing digital shopping culture?
project.title: STRP - Infinity

project.resume:
I have been and am working on Virtual Reality projects for storyteller and artist Abner Preis, who portrays the present reality from a hopeful vantage point in his new media works. I work on the VR coding and animations of his with Google Tilt Brush drawn scenes.

2023 - On display at the Amsterdam Museum is VR experience 'Blooming in a Ring of Fire', containing 5 stories of women on the run. In co-creation with Zoe d'Amaro.

2022 - On display at the Amsterdam Museum is VR experience 'Corona in de stad', a 3 story piece on the influence of Corona the past years.

2021 - **Official Cinekid selection, part of IDFA DocLab Spotlight and Venice Immersive 2022**, [The Miracle Basket](https://www.abnerpreis.com/miracle) shows the need for humanity to reconnect with nature and our ancestor's knowledge to avoid disassociation and a demise of our planet through our consumerist behaviour.
The Miracle Basket is also on display at the Museum Arnhem. 

2021 - A short VR movie on [The Golden Rule](https://jck.nl/nl/tentoonstelling/eden-en-de-gulden-regel) is on display at the Jewish History Museum.

2021 - For Hewlett-Packard we created a short VR movie about working from home of which you can see a video version [online](https://player.vimeo.com/video/539517977).
project.title: Abner Preis

project.resume:
Symbiosis is a multiuser and multisensory Mixed Reality experience inspired by the work of science historian and philosopher Donna Haraway, that takes place 200 years in the future in a post-human biotope of artificial or enhanced biochemcial life. It allows every participant to embody a post-human or even nonhuman reality: a completely symbiotic human-animal or human-technologic relationship.
**Symbiosis won the IDFA award for Best Creative Technology 2021 and was part of IDFA Doclab's 2020 Competition for Immersive Non-Fiction**.

I worked on the VR coding in Unity with C#, NodeJS for the multiuser server part, and modeling/animating in Blender.
project.title: Symbiosis

project.resume:
For [Fondation Constant](https://stichtingconstant.nl/about-fondation-constant) I coached and helped teams of young writers and scenographers to create 4 Mixed Reality installations based on artist Constant Nieuwenhuijs' work New Babylon and the 3D visualization of Constant's Yellow Sector by artist Dennis Molema. In Enter New Babylon the teams give their take on Constant's ideas of a world for playful and creative humans. All 4 installations were on display at Over het IJ festival 2021 in Amsterdam.

Based on prototypes the teams made in VR software Neos I coded and designed the end result in Unity. Impressions of both the virtual and mixed reality part can be found on the Fondation Constant' [project page](https://constant101.nl/projects/enter-new-babylon).
project.title: Enter New Babylon

project.resume:
Distance Disco is a digital matchmaking dance party: find the person dancing to your song! With Covid-19 keeping us away from concerts & festivals how do we get our dancing juices flowing? Well, just turn on your webcam open a browser and let's go. Host your own party at [https://distancedisco.nl/](https://distancedisco.nl/) or join one of the regulars.

For Distance Disco I'm working on the React front end and thinking of more interactive ways of bridging social distance. When needed I'm also dabbing in the Erlang back end.
project.shoutout: As part of the Distance Disco team
project.title: Distance Disco

project.resume:
Dustin is a mobile, interactive Augmented Reality story about our relationship with smart devices. In this case an AI vacuum cleaner called Dustin. **The app is [nominated](https://www.filmfestival.nl/digitale-cultuur/) for the Gouden Kalf Digitale Cultuur award of the Nederlands Film Festival 2021**.

I programmed this mobile AR app with Unity/C#/Objective C and it integrates with native phone functions like your calendar and photo library to really let Dustin become part of your daily life.
project.shoutout: Made for VPRO, with writer Niels 't Hooft
project.title: Dustin

project.resume: A 13-minute room scale Virtual Reality war epos, set in the Eastern-Ukrainian war zone of 2014 for which I did the VR coding and 3D modeling. It was part of **IDFA Doclab's 2019 competition for Immersive Non-Fiction** and is still viewable on request.
project.shoutout: Made as part of Studio ZZZap
project.title: Rozsypne

project.resume:
For the biggest part of my professional career I’ve worked as a full stack developer in a small Scrum team at innovative Dutch public broadcaster VPRO. We not only developed the sites and API’s of [our company](https://www.vpro.nl), but also of other Dutch broadcasters and platforms like [Human.nl](https://www.human.nl), [2doc.nl](https://www.2doc.nl) and the back end of [NPO Start](https://www.npostart.nl/). Besides that we created mobile apps with React Native, VR and AR productions and countless experimental projects to explore new ways of storytelling.

Most of the experimental projects were done with Node.js and CouchDB back ends. From the highly used [Kringloopwinkel ](https://kringloopwinkel.op.vpro.nl/) with User Generated Content, to the very effective and reusable (2 times yearly) VPRO Tegenlicht [Pioniers ](https://pioniers.op.vpro.nl/) contest. We developed our own in-house NPM modules on a private Nexus repository as well as contributed to open source projects.

With a small team I've watched and helped the front end profession grow from jQuery-users to the amazing full stack  community that it is today. At the end of my career at VPRO I was training 4 front enders enjoying the possibilities of their skills to create projects that connect people with purpose.
project.title: VPRO

project.resume:
With Hackastory I’ve coached and coded during numerous international hackathons (short, creative pressure cooker events), where we helped media companies around the world finding solutions to complex problems in the media industry.

I especially loved coaching a group of people that often never met before. To let them team up, come up with crazy ideas that make them laugh, and then cheer when they realise them by working together, playing and letting go of boundaries and disciplines.
project.title: Hackastory

project.resume:
At Chevalier Media I was responsible for the front end and back end (ASP / PHP, MySQL, SQL Server) development of numerous websites, promosites, Flash banners and animations using a variety of programming languages. 

Besides that I was part of a team of 3 technicians developing and implementing Chevalier Media's Matruska product line, a series of webapplications for rich media publication. Applications focussing on live/on-demand Narrowcasting, content management and video messaging.

We provided services for clients like Siemens, Deloitte, Pearle, Eye Wish, De Bijenkorf and V&D.
project.title: Chevalier Media

resume.spare_time: When not developing you can catch me designing t-shirts, on a skateboard, dancing at a music festival, making playlists, playing at my table soccer club or reading a good book.
